topic: XRP collateral eligibility, institutional margin, and Ripple Prime financing

constraints.concentration: Per-organization UBO limits based on average daily quantity (ADQ); excess above the limit does not contribute to portfolio value.
constraints.valuation: Notional value multiplied by collateral weight.
constraints.haircut: Collateral weight equals 1 minus collateral haircut; the greater of base haircut and closeout-horizon haircut applies.
constraints.liquidation: Automatic collateral liquidation can occur when portfolio margin falls below maintenance margin.

xrp_perpetual.note: Leverage limits, collateral weights and account eligibility are product/jurisdiction specific.

coinbase_global_exchange.utilization: Coinbase does not publish XRP collateral balances, UBO concentration utilization or XRP-specific margin notional in the reviewed help pages.

ripple_prime.collateral_page: Ripple Prime's official product page lists RLUSD, XRP, tokenized real-world assets and traditional collateral as assets that can be posted; supported assets margin supported positions in a single cross-margin pool.
ripple_prime.distinction: RLUSD is explicitly described as accepted collateral; the product page also lists XRP as a postable asset but does not publish XRP-specific eligibility by position, haircut or utilization.
ripple_prime.xrp_services: Ripple Prime launched U.S. OTC spot prime brokerage in XRP and RLUSD in November 2025; cross-margining covers OTC spot holdings and eligible derivatives.
ripple_prime.actual_usage: No public XRP collateral balance, XRP-backed loan notional, haircut schedule or borrower-level breakdown was found.

ripple_prime_financing.neuberger_status: closed facility; Ripple says it can draw up to $200M; actual drawn balance not disclosed
ripple_prime_financing.neuberger_purpose: Extend financing to clients in traditional and digital markets; increase Ripple Prime lending capacity.
ripple_prime_financing.senior_notes_status: upsized private placement of senior unsecured notes closed 2026-08-18; BBB rating reported by Ripple/KBRA
ripple_prime_financing.senior_notes_purpose: Working capital and general corporate purposes within a regulated entity.
ripple_prime_financing.interpretation: The $475M sum combines a draw facility (up to $200M, drawn amount unknown) and $275M notes issued. It is not $475M of XRP purchases, XRP collateral, or confirmed deployed client credit.

cross_market_access.ripple_prime_to_coinbase: Nodal Clear confirms Ripple Prime clients can access Coinbase Derivatives contracts, including XRP futures, through Nodal Clear.
cross_market_access.access_vs_usage: This proves an institutional access path, not attributable client volume, open interest, spot buying or collateral posted.

confirmed: Coinbase Global Exchange help pages currently list XRP as accepted perpetual-futures collateral.
Coinbase applies ADQ-based UBO concentration limits and collateral haircuts.
Ripple Prime's official product page lists XRP as a postable collateral asset within its cross-margin pool.
Ripple Prime closed a $200M Neuberger facility and a separate $275M senior-notes offering.
company_reported: Ripple said client collateral doubled after the Hidden Road acquisition and average daily transactions exceeded 60M; the release does not break out XRP versus RLUSD.
unknown: XRP balances actually pledged at Coinbase or Ripple Prime
XRP collateral haircuts and concentration utilization by client
XRP-backed loan notional, liquidation history and borrower distribution
actual amount drawn under the $200M facility
allocation of the $275M notes to XRP-related activity

demand_interpretation.positive_channel: Collateral eligibility can increase the utility of holding XRP and may reduce the need to sell XRP to obtain margin/credit.
demand_interpretation.counter_hypothesis: Collateral eligibility can be used with existing inventory and does not require fresh spot purchases; haircuts, concentration limits and risk appetite may constrain use.
demand_interpretation.model_rule: Do not count eligible collateral as actual collateral. Require reported posted balances, utilization, haircuts, loan notional, client/venue coverage and time-series changes before estimating incremental XRP demand.
